items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: Yeah, when I was in school I went to music lessons or piano. Uh-huh. And that's about three or four months then after I stopped. Uh-huh. Her name was Mrs. Florence Pemberton.

ctx.x: I might even have his address in my old notes, but I used to try to find him. Uh-huh. I used to take notes when I'd go to visit you about and talk to Bunk sometime, but I don't know where I'd find him, right, in a hurry. To return back to your life, did you ever take up any instrument when you were young and learn any? No.
Uh-huh. Yeah, when I was in school I went to music lessons or piano. Uh-huh. And that's about three or four months then after I stopped. Uh-huh. Her name was Mrs. Florence Pemberton. Uh-huh.
Did you learn to play pretty well or did you give it up before you?
